Manifest.Name: 巨型水箱 / Mega Water Tank
Manifest.Author: 核桃
Manifest.Description:
大容量储水装置：0.1 吨（100 升）起步的主池 + 16 个内胆槽，满了自动溢出到内胆、不足时自动回补。 装的是真水，水培机和净水机都认。水色会随水质变化。电话下单、每天可再买， 还能重复购买扩容服务，每档 +100 升，升满 1.9 吨。设置面板支持中英俄三语。
Large water tank: starts at 0.1 t (100 L) with 16 insert cells, auto overflow and refill. Holds real water that hydroponics and purifiers recognize; colour changes with water quality. Order by phone, repeatable daily; expand capacity +100 L per purchase (no cooldown), up to 1.9 t. Settings in Chinese, English and Russian.
